description: Judge a UK buy-to-let at a given price and postcode, for this buyer: purchase tax for the right nation (SDLT, Welsh LTT, Scottish LBTT with the supplement), lender interest cover at 125% and 145%, monthly cashflow, gross and net yield, stress tests (rates +2 points, a 10% fall, voids), where the price sits among local sales, the objections and a verdict (CLEARS, MARGINAL or DOES NOT CLEAR), from Clarity's location report for that authority. A modelled purchase in an area, not a valuation of an address; research, not financial advice. Costs $0.50 USDC per call; district LS6 is free.

cash.description: Buyer's cash available, GBP. Given, the check tests whether it covers the cash needed.

deposit.description: Deposit, percent of price (25 means 25%). Default 25.

mortgage.description: Default true; false models a cash purchase.

otherPropertyOwned.description: Default true: additional-dwelling purchase tax rates.

postcode.description: A UK postcode (M14 5RX) or postcode district (M14). England, Wales and Scotland.

propertyType.description: Picks the rent and the comparables. Default: the area's entry-level stock.

rent.description: Expected rent, GBP a month. Default: the ONS median for that kind of home in the authority.

ukResident.description: Default true; false adds England's 2% non-resident surcharge.

name: check_deal
title: Check a buy-to-let deal
